authoritative_image_population.rule: Use every unique full mammogram referenced by the four CSV image file path columns; group all source rows sharing that full-image Series Instance UID into one output record.
authoritative_image_population.identity_key: Series Instance UID embedded in image file path
authoritative_image_population.source_row_granularity: one abnormality on one mammography view
authoritative_image_population.local_asset_status: blocked: only 2 of 3103 authoritative full-image series are locally present

stable_ordering.records: Lexicographic ascending order by full-image Series Instance UID.
stable_ordering.findings_within_record: Ascending integer abnormality_id, then source filename, then one-based CSV data row number.
stable_ordering.json_serialization: UTF-8 JSON Lines with compact separators and stable insertion order.

identifier_and_path_derivation.image_id: Use the full-image Series Instance UID exactly as supplied by the CSV path and matched 1:1 to Metadata.Series Instance UID.

image_path.rule: Inventory the approved complete source-image root, match each full-image Series Instance UID to exactly one DICOM file, and write that actual file path relative to the approved source-image root.
constraints: Do not emit the non-resolving logical CSV path as image_path.
Reject missing or multiple local DICOM matches for any authoritative full-image Series Instance UID.
Ensure every normalized path remains beneath the approved source-image root.

identifier_and_path_derivation.patient_id: Use CSV patient_id exactly as a string.
identifier_and_path_derivation.case_id: Deterministically join split, abnormality type, patient_id, and laterality with ':' so CC and MLO views of the same breast case share a case_id while train/test and calcification/mass namespaces remain distinct.
identifier_and_path_derivation.study_id: Use Metadata.Study Instance UID from the 1:1 full-image Series Instance UID join.
identifier_and_path_derivation.finding_id: Deterministically join split, abnormality type, patient_id, laterality, and integer abnormality_id with ':'; this follows info.md while preventing cross-split and cross-type collisions.

joins.left: CSV path embedded Series Instance UID

joins.right: local DICOM inventory beneath approved source-image root

top_level_mapping.image_path: actual matched DICOM path relative to the approved complete source-image root

modality.provenance: Metadata.Modality after the full-image Series Instance UID join

anatomy.provenance: Metadata.Body Part Examined after the full-image Series Instance UID join

breast.source_row_entity: values that are consistent across all CSV rows grouped under one full image

fields.density: breast density or breast_density, preserved as integer
fields.laterality: left or right breast, preserved as source string
fields.view: image view, preserved as source string
fields.split: train or test derived from the source filename
fields.abnormality_type: abnormality type, preserved as source string

findings.source_row_entity: one finding object per CSV row on the full image

calcification_fields.calc_type: calc type, source string or null
calcification_fields.calc_distribution: calc distribution, source string or null

mass_fields.mass_shape: mass shape, source string or null
mass_fields.mass_margins: mass margins, source string or null

source_image_references.cropped_image: Preserve the source logical path plus its embedded Study Instance UID, Series Instance UID, and filename in the same finding object.
source_image_references.roi_mask: Preserve the source logical path plus its embedded Study Instance UID, Series Instance UID, and filename in the same finding object.

bbox.status: pending explicit approval and complete mask assets
bbox.proposed_rule: Decode only the CSV-designated ROI mask for the same source row and derive the tight axis-aligned [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] box enclosing all nonzero pixels in full-mammogram pixel coordinates.
validation_requirements: Resolve the downloaded local DICOM instance corresponding exactly to the CSV ROI mask filename.
Confirm the mask dimensions and coordinate space match the associated full mammogram.
Reject empty masks, multi-valued role ambiguity, dimension mismatches, or unresolved downloaded-filename mappings.
Do not infer a box from a cropped image or image appearance.

metadata_administrative_columns.reason: Administrative, download, licensing, or redundant collection metadata is not an image annotation; licensing provenance remains in source_inventory.json.

metadata_patient_id.reason: These workbook fields are series-level collection labels such as a view or ROI series name; canonical patient_id comes from the CSV patient_id field.

conflict_and_grouping_policy.full_image_consistency: patient_id, density, laterality, view, split, and abnormality type have zero conflicts within all 3103 full-image groups.
conflict_and_grouping_policy.one_to_many_policy: Emit exactly one output record per full image and preserve every grouped CSV source row as a distinct finding object.
conflict_and_grouping_policy.cross_view_policy: Use the documented lesion identity only for finding_id. Do not merge CC and MLO source rows or select one view's values for the other view.

series_description_role_conflicts.policy: Preserve the CSV field designation and workbook description without silently rewriting either. Bounding-box derivation must stop for any instance whose local file role cannot be proven.

unresolved_decisions.question: Which directory contains the complete downloaded CBIS-DDSM DICOM population?
unresolved_decisions.impact: The current dataset root has only 2 of 3103 authoritative full images, so canonical image_path values cannot all resolve and conversion cannot pass validation.

unresolved_decisions.question: What authoritative manifest or DICOM identifier mapping should relate downloaded filenames such as 1-1.dcm and 1-2.dcm to the CSV filenames 000000.dcm and 000001.dcm?
unresolved_decisions.impact: This is required to identify crop versus mask instances in 3464 shared two-image series without inference.

unresolved_decisions.question: Do you explicitly approve decoding the CSV-designated ROI mask DICOMs to derive tight axis-aligned bounding boxes after exact instance mapping and coordinate-space validation?
unresolved_decisions.impact: Without approval, findings will preserve mask references but will not contain derived bbox values.

implementation_gate.reason: The selected skill requires explicit mapping approval, and the complete source-image population plus exact downloaded-instance mapping are unresolved.
